name: Cloth Request
summary: At the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, Rema Schneider receives Harlan Bagley's request for fresh cloth and knitted goods. His shelves are emptying quickly.

sections.title: A Run on Sturdy Goods
sections.body: Harlan Bagley asks Rema Schneider for fresh cloth and knitted garments. Trade has surged without warning. Citizens and travelers buy armor and sturdy clothing as if a brutal season were coming. The rush leaves Rema puzzled and wary. The House of Nobles has announced no open war, so she wonders why city folk are quietly armoring themselves and whether the crown's leaders are hiding unrest.

faq.answer: Harlan Bagley's written order asks Rema Schneider to supply fresh cloth and knitted wear for his store.

faq.q: Why does Harlan Bagley need more cloth?
aliases: why is bagley out of stock
faq.answer: Bagley's business has been unusually busy. Townsfolk and travelers have bought armor and sturdy clothing in large quantities, leaving his shelves nearly empty.

faq.q: Where does this request need to go?
aliases: where do i take the cloth request
faq.answer: The order goes to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop along Stormwind's waterways.

faq.q: Why are people in Stormwind buying so much armor and clothing?
faq.answer: Neither merchants nor commoners know for certain. The sudden rush unnerves Rema Schneider, who wonders whether the noble court is concealing brewing hostilities or danger from the public.

angles.text: The request points to Stormwind's textile trade. Neighborhood clothiers like the Schneiders supply general stores and outfitters with woven goods.
Stormwind's citizens feel uneasy and prepare for strife, though the regency has made no official announcements.
